name: Rajdarshan Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Rajdarshan Industries Ltd is engaged in the trading of quarts and minerals[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RDIL undertook drilling operations and business of mining, manufacturing, and trading of all types of minerals. It also worked in the field of raising limestone and removal of overburden, including transportation thereof on a hire/contract basis for various cement plants. At present, the company's engaged in the business of trading of Quartz grit, powder, and related consumables on a commission basis

pros: Stock is trading at 0.79 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.96% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 281 days.
